C-1229

January 22, 2025
The claimant reported a left-turn collision at an intersection and said a vehicle coming straight through struck the
driver's side of their car. The claim was opened the same day and the file was assigned for review.
January 29, 2025
The driver is named on the policy, and the policy was in force at the time of the reported loss. Nothing in the
underwriting file suggests the vehicle damage predates the covearge start.
April 3, 2025
Police attended the scene and confirmed the claimant was in the vehicle at the time. Two officers' notes are on file
and they match the claimant's first account.
May 11, 2025
Photos taken at the scene confirm several details of the reported impact. The vehicle damage is consistent with the
described angle and direction of the collision.
May 19, 2025
No independent witnesses have come forward, so the account rests on the claimant's statement, the photos, and the
police report. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known from prior claims or inspection records.
May 21, 2025
The claimant reported neck pain shortly after the collision and was seen at an urgent care clinic. No earlier injury to
the same body area is known from the medical history provided.
July 1, 2025
The claimant has since added a few small details to the account, such as the position of the signal and the speed of
the other car. The core sequence of events has stayed the same across each retelling.
July 24, 2025
Treatment for the neck strain followed a usual course of physical therapy and medication. Reports show steady
improvement, and the treatment has tapered off as the patient recovered.
August 25, 2025
It is not yet clear whteher the neck injury came from this crash, as the medical records and the timing of symptoms
are still being reviewed. The file remains open pending the treating provider's causation opinion.
September 3, 2025
The claimant is not represented by an attorney and has been dealing with the adjuster directly. The file will be
reviewed again once the remaining mdeical records are received.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
